title: Obstacle Course Challenge - Aggressive Speed Test
goal_description: Propose a supervised research mission to test aggressive speed

hypotheses.title: Increasing Max Linear Velocity
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the maximum linear velocity of the robot will allow it to reach the goal faster, but may increase the risk of collisions.
hypotheses.mechanism: By increasing the robot's maximum linear velocity, the robot can cover more ground in less time, potentially reducing the time to goal and improving overall efficiency.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Safety Margin
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will make the robot more aggressive in its path planning, potentially reducing the time to goal but increasing the risk of collisions.
hypotheses.mechanism: By reducing the safety margin, the robot will be allowed to come closer to obstacles, which can reduce the distance it needs to travel and thus reduce the time to goal.
